## What changed

Describe the evidence workflow, implementation, and user-facing behavior.

## Why

Explain the concrete evidence-synthesis or replication-planning problem.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit and integration tests
- [ ] Malformed-input or tamper test where relevant
- [ ] Deterministic demo and repository audit
- [ ] Documentation or screenshots updated where relevant
- [ ] No private, copyrighted, or proprietary source material

## Evidence boundary

State what the change can establish and what remains a reviewer judgment. Note
any effect on scoring, missing-evidence handling, uncertainty, or triage order.

## Compatibility

- [ ] No schema or artifact-format changes
- [ ] Schema or artifact-format changes are versioned and documented
- [ ] Existing workspaces remain readable
